appdetails: LTI integration — teacher dashboard and component launch

testcase.description: Launch LTI teacher dashboard via BB Content Market and verify it loaded
Verify teacher dashboard content — course title, school name, duration, product name, action buttons
Click PE component from LTI Test product and verify PE page state — back button, teacher mode URL, TOC heading text, TOC items, activity iframe
Click Ebook component from LTI Test product and verify component page
Verify teacher PE deeplink page — activity iframe loaded, no back button, TOC shows no activity scores
Verify student PE deeplink page — activity iframe loaded, no back button, TOC shows retained activity scores
Verify ebook deeplink page — ebook viewer guard visible, toolbar visible
